g.text: Company cases teach mechanisms, not one architecture
Use a peer pattern to generate a design or evaluation question; assess maturity and effects separately.

g.text: Compare equivalent work. Architecture describes intended operation; production use shows adoption. Neither establishes
quality, net time saved or causal value. This selected map is not a representative survey or a firm-maturity ranking.
The source HTML contains an expanded 25-firm atlas. Company affiliation alone does not establish deployment of every discussed technique.
